microbench_chunk_regime.verdict: GO at every ctx (the beat-fp8-prefill NO-GO arm was 0.60-0.72x)

lever_verdicts.A_fp8_qk_mma: GO — m16n8k32.e4m3 f32-acc on raw Ks8; Q per-row e4m3 once/q-tile in A-fragment order; dequantK + barrier deleted; 4 independent QMMA chains
lever_verdicts.A_scale_prefetch: GO — tile-top gmem scale loads stalled the block at the post-WAIT_K barrier (11.3ms of 51ms at 32k -> 0.8ms)
lever_verdicts.A_own_bytes_v_dequant: GO — each thread converts exactly the bytes it cp.async-staged; no visibility barrier; fp8 arm barrier count == bf16
lever_verdicts.A_fp16_v_dequant: GO — single cvt.f16x2.e4m3x2, vsc folded into V, P unscaled half2, P.V = f16-operand mma
lever_verdicts.B_softmax: mostly pre-optimized (FA_EXP already raw ex2, 3.4% of wall); corr-rescale ballot-skip NO-GO (-8%, defeats mma scheduler; PLOW_NV_FA_CORRSKIP=0)
lever_verdicts.C_fp8_pv: NOT TAKEN — needs BKV=32 to fill k32 AND V^T (kv-contiguous) via in-kernel transpose or V^T cache; f16-mma P.V already removed the dequant round-trip
lever_verdicts.D_bkv32_all_fp8: NOT TAKEN — gated behind C; all-fp8 smem plan (~59 KiB) documented in plans/beat-fp8-mma-prefill.md
